pools.t: A push is a push. Land exactly on the number and it counts as neither a win nor a loss, and it stays out of your percentage entirely.
Join survivor late and you arrive having already spent the biggest favourite of every week you missed.
Nobody sees anybody else's picks until the slate locks. The consensus is withheld for the same reason: it would be worth following.
One line for the whole room, frozen the moment the week is published. Whatever the market does afterwards, everybody is still playing the number you saw.
Signing in asks your provider for one thing — that you are you. No email address, no name, no picture.
Survivor gives you one team a week and never the same team twice. Sixteen teams, and the season is longer than that.
The 2026 market has opened on 7 games so far. Games without a posted line are shown, and are not pickable.
The board shows the chalk: what simply taking every favourite would have scored. In 2025 that was 56.5%, and most people do not beat it.
